_metadata.training_span_rule: Intersection of train sample calendar footprints (input start through target), not just sample-start dates
_metadata.rounding: Python round(percent * total_blocks / 100), ties to even
_metadata.coverage_definition: Union of all 44-day sample windows; denominator is blocking_training_span.days
_metadata.season_definition: Block midpoint start + 44 days (earlier central day of a 90-day block)
_metadata.ranking: One seeded base season order, left-rotated by period index 0..3; shuffled blocks within seasons; season round-robin then fixed shuffled period round-robin; ratio selections are prefixes
